text.p: Profit forecasts for British retailer Kingfisher Plc were upgraded more or less across the board on Wednesday after the firm reported record profits and strong sales.
Retail analysts said they were impressed with the group's market share gains and efficiency improvements.
Dealers said Dresdner Kleinwort Benson had upgraded its forecast for the current year to 440 million stg from 427 million.
Other analysts, who asked not to be identified, also raised their forecasts by between five and 10 million stg to 440 million.
Earlier the retailer reported a 36 percent increase in annual profits to 390.2 million stg and said trading so far this year had been encouraging.

Some said although they were pleased by the performance, 1997/98 would be a more difficult year. "Last year was the bounce back year, this year will be more demanding," said one, who asked not to be named.
But he said the shares were attractive as they were on a market rating. By 1505 GMT they were 24 pence up at 698.5 pence.
